targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-778c (diagnostic, n=8, 2026-07-18) ran the pre-registered zero-injected-content null control and FAILED the load-bearing C1 on 0/8 seeds. Per phase: nrem null_slope_ratio 0.1445 (95% CI [0.1438, 0.1451], 0/8 confounded) is cleanly content-contingent; sws is 1.0000 (sd 2.7e-8, 8/8 confounded) -- denoising_snr_db is a pure noise-power statistic whose content term differentiates away, so it has never measured content fidelity; rem is degenerate at both rails (exactly 0.0 on 5/8 from a saturated calibration_error constant, off-scale 1801-9143 on 3/8 from the 1e-3 precision floor) and is UNINTERPRETABLE at this n (ceiling_inside_ci95 true). Readiness precondition met and C2 passed, so this is an informative negative about the instrument, not a broken run. Per the script's own pre-registration (lines 90-92), SD-068's non-vacuity contract is hereby NARROWED rather than withdrawn: it is carried by the nrem injected-content leg and the REM passthrough-vs-generative contrast, and NOT by the sws leg. Routing: /implement-substrate to replace sws_denoising_snr with a content-scored readout (same pattern as rem_terrain_variance -> rem_generative_fidelity, ree-v3 main da873a1). No status or confidence change; diagnostic evidence does not weight governance confidence. See failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-778c_2026-07-18.

recommended_annotation_amendments.text: AMENDED 2026-07-18 by V3-EXQ-778c (SD-068 null-content control, n=8). The "NREM-before-SWS adjacency ROBUST (8/8, sign-test p = 0.0078, 95% CI [0.422, 0.425])" half of the 2026-07-17 V3-EXQ-778a staging fold is RETRACTED as evidence of staging: the sws pole of that adjacency is a content-free readout (null_slope_ratio 1.0000 on 8/8 seeds, sd 2.7e-8), so the comparison is between a content-contingent readout (nrem) and a noise statistic (sws). The tightness of that CI is the signature of a near-deterministic analytic metric, not strength of effect -- sws tolerance std ~9e-9 vs nrem 0.0014 and rem 0.396. The REM-fails-first half was already CONTESTED / underpowered and is unchanged. The 2026-07-17 Leg 2 finding (REM generative gain 0.149, 8/8 attenuating) is a different readout and is NOT overturned, though see failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-778c_2026-07-18 H3 for an open question on its content-dependence. No confidence change: V3-EXQ-778c tags these claims as CONTEXT only and its per-claim evidence_direction is unknown. This amends an annotation, not the claims themselves.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1: three distinct design axes (measurement / representation / observation), each with a declared null. Motivated by the observation that null-arm rem_generative_gain (~0.182-0.209 on seed 42) is close to the injected arm's (~0.165-0.190) at rem_gen_content_scale 0.0 -- outside the scored C1 criteria, recorded as an open question rather than a verdict.

learning_extracted: The SWS leg of the SD-068 staging order has never measured content fidelity: denoising_snr_db is a pure noise-power statistic.

A per-phase variance three-to-five orders of magnitude below its siblings (sws std ~9e-9 vs nrem 0.0014, rem 0.396) is an instrument-validity flag, not a strength-of-effect signal. This retro-explains the suspiciously tight CI [0.422, 0.425] read as robustness on 2026-07-17.
The V3-EXQ-778a Leg 1 headline ('nrem fails before sws -- ROBUST, 8/8, p = 0.0078') is retracted as evidence of staging: it compares a content-contingent readout against a content-free one.

Leg 2 (REM generative gain 0.149, 8/8 attenuating) is a different readout with its own internal control and is NOT overturned by C1; but the null arm's near-identical gain at content_scale 0.0 opens H3 against the doc's 'correction needs an intact seed' gloss.

An injected-content harness should ship its zero-content null arm in the SAME cycle as its first scored run. This control cost ~13.5 min of cloud compute and invalidated a headline result banked the previous day.
The harness's CONFOUND REGISTER design -- report and flag confounded phases, never silently drop them from the staging order -- is what made this finding legible rather than invisible.
